title: Bitcoin Price Slumps Under $62,000, Crashing 25% in One Month
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Slumps Under $62,000, Crashing 25% in One Month The bitcoin price slumped under $62,000 on Thursday, down about 24% in one month, as Anthropic's Nasdaq debut set off a tech selloff that hit crypto stocks. This post Bitcoin Price Slumps Under $62,000, Crashing 25% in One Month first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
